briefing:
The Lumen Ridge Eastside clinic is moving toward its first day of patient appointments, which is planned for Wednesday 25 August 2027. This note pulls together the latest status updates and emails so the main points sit in one place.

On the building side, Amara Kowalczyk owns the fit-out workstream, and the fit-out is scheduled to end on Monday 8 March 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Staffing runs in parallel under Rafael Fontaine, who owns the clinical staffing workstream. The staff induction day is on Monday 5 April 2027. Unfilled nurse vacancies could delay the first day of patient appointments.

Equipment is the next stage after the building work. Equipment installation can begin 8 working days after the building fit-out ends. The plan provides for 37 treatment chairs, and an additional 2 treatment chairs were approved in March. The imaging equipment lease is worth €15,000. Higher energy tariffs could affect the budget.

On funding, the approved project budget is €299,000. The steering group approved an increase of €40,000 to the project budget in March, and that approval was made in the same month as the chair decision. Late delivery of the X-ray unit could delay the first day of patient appointments.

Several other workstreams have named owners. Thandiwe Iyer owns the regulatory approval workstream, and the inspection visit is on Monday 12 July 2027. Dmitri Petrov owns the patient records workstream, while Tomasz Bakshi owns the community outreach workstream, which covers the clinic's engagement with local residents ahead of opening.

The pharmacy stock delivery is on Thursday 12 August 2027, which comes after the inspection visit and ahead of the first day of patient appointments. Updates from each workstream owner will continue to feed into this briefing as they arrive. Low early patient uptake could affect the number of treatment chairs.
